name: Sphere Intersection
aliases: Ray-Marching: Sphere Intersection and Path Calculation
definition: A method to render a volumetric sphere by intersecting camera rays with the sphere geometry to determine entry and exit points, then applying Beer's Law along the chord length.
summary: Sphere Intersection calculates exact ray entry and exit points for volumetric rendering using Beer's Law, distinguishing itself from ray-box intersection by providing an analytical solution for spherical primitives.
